items.title: Mum rescued from Venezuela rubble with newborn baby tells BBC how he helped her survive
items.description: The "miracle" rescue of 18-day-old baby Juan David is a symbol of hope in Venezuela after the devastating earthquakes.

items.title: US says it has agreed to 'stand down' after exchange of strikes with Iran
items.description: A series of strikes over the weekend saw the US and Iran accuse each other of violating the ceasefire agreement.

items.title: Pakistani strikes kill dozens in Afghanistan
items.description: The Taliban government says civilians were killed, while Pakistan maintains they targeted militants.

items.title: South Korea football coach quits as president calls for probe into World Cup loss
items.description: South Korea was eliminated after missing out on a spot among the eight best third-placed teams.

items.title: 'You are Canadian heroes' - the forgotten hosts making World Cup history
items.description: Canada are making history at this World Cup with a run that is likely to change the face of football in the country forever.

items.title: Senior South African police officer survives assassination attempt
items.description: Deputy crime intelligence boss Maj-Gen Feroz Khan was due to appear before an inquiry into police corruption this week.

items.title: Fitness brand founder and Olympian Les Mills dies aged 91
items.description: The Les Mills International brand is now known globally for choreographed workouts set to music, like Body Pump and Body Combat.

items.title: Indian journalists condemn 'denial' of voting and passport rights of prominent editor
items.description: Rajagopal has alleged that he has been unable to renew his passport after his name was deleted from the electoral rolls.

items.title: Europe's heatwave linked to 1,300 deaths, WHO says, as Germany hits record 41.7C
items.description: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that Europe is not prepared for high temperatures.

items.title: First dinosaur bone from Antarctica found in a drawer
items.description: The fossil, collected in Antarctica in 1985, is part of the tail of a beast called a Titanosaur.

items.title: Australian man charged with murder after dead girl found in suitcase in Thailand
items.description: The body of Tunchanok Donhomla, 17, was found discarded near a railway track on Saturday, police say.

items.title: Eleven killed after plane carrying skydivers crashes in eastern France
items.description: The pilot and 10 passengers - including five first-time parachutists - died in the incident, local officials said.
